description: This file defines a Jinja2-based template engine for generating HTML, CSS, and JavaScript artifacts for a website. It includes functions to set up the environment, render site pages, styles, and scripts based on provided contexts.

methods.name: Environment _build_env()
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Jinja2 Environment configured for loading templates and autoescaping.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] render_site( site_ctx: Dict[str, Any], pages: List[Dict[str, Any]], theme_branding: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Renders a complete website into a dictionary mapping file paths to their content, including styles, scripts, and pages.

ctags.name: render_site
ctags.signature: ( site_ctx: Dict[str, Any], pages: List[Dict[str, Any]], theme_branding: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
